rubric.correctness: Can the student explain classification vs regression, loss functions, gradient descent, and model training loops?
rubric.depth: Does the student understand bias-variance trade-off, regularisation (L1/L2), and generalisation theory?
rubric.tradeoffAwareness: When to use linear models vs tree-based models vs neural networks for tabular data?
rubric.realWorldApplicability: Can the student design a supervised pipeline (feature engineering → training → evaluation → deployment) for customer churn prediction?

rubric.correctness: Can the student compute and interpret accuracy, precision, recall, F1, ROC-AUC, and RMSE?
rubric.depth: Does the student understand class imbalance, calibration, cross-validation, and statistical significance of results?
rubric.tradeoffAwareness: When to optimise precision vs recall? Why is accuracy misleading on imbalanced datasets?
rubric.realWorldApplicability: Can the student select the right evaluation metric for a medical diagnosis model vs a spam filter vs a ranking system?

rubric.correctness: Can the student apply one-hot encoding, normalisation, imputation, and target encoding correctly?
rubric.depth: Does the student understand feature selection methods (mutual information, SHAP), dimensionality reduction (PCA), and leakage?
rubric.tradeoffAwareness: When to use tree-based models that handle raw categoricals vs models requiring encoded features?
rubric.realWorldApplicability: Can the student engineer features from raw transaction logs to improve fraud detection recall by 15%?

rubric.correctness: Can the student explain forward pass, backpropagation, activation functions, and optimisers (SGD, Adam)?
rubric.depth: Does the student understand vanishing gradients, batch normalisation, dropout, and architecture choices (CNN, RNN, Transformer)?
rubric.tradeoffAwareness: When is a deep neural network justified vs a gradient-boosted tree? Data vs model complexity trade-offs?
rubric.realWorldApplicability: Can the student design a CNN for image classification or a Transformer fine-tuning pipeline for NLP tasks?

rubric.correctness: Can the student explain k-means, hierarchical clustering, DBSCAN, and dimensionality reduction (t-SNE, UMAP)?
rubric.depth: Does the student understand inertia, silhouette score, and how to choose the number of clusters (elbow method)?
rubric.tradeoffAwareness: When is unsupervised learning appropriate vs semi-supervised vs self-supervised learning?
rubric.realWorldApplicability: Can the student apply clustering to customer segmentation or anomaly detection without labelled data?
